itemblocker.text.items_handled: Choose how blocked items are handled:
itemblocker.text.works_on_server: - Works on any server without server-side installation
itemblocker.text.automatically: - Automatically drops picked up blocked items
itemblocker.text.briefly_show: - May briefly show items in inventory before dropping
itemblocker.text.no_pickup: - Prevents items from being picked up at all
itemblocker.text.server_installation: - REQUIRES mod to be installed on the server
itemblocker.text.wont_work: - Will not work on servers without the mod
itemblocker.text.restart_note: Note: Restart may be required for changes to take effect
itemblocker.text.enter_name: Enter a name for your preset:
itemblocker.text.after_creation: After creating, you can add items to this preset.
itemblocker.text.no_preset_items: No items in this preset yet
itemblocker.text.invalid: Invalid preset code! Make sure you copied it correctly.
itemblocker.text.paste_code_shared: Paste a preset code shared by another player:
itemblocker.text.preset_contains: The preset code contains the name and all items.
itemblocker.text.press_copy_key: Press Ctrl+C to copy the code below:
itemblocker.text.share_code: Share this code with other players!
itemblocker.text.other_player_info: They can paste it using 'Import Preset'.
itemblocker.text.item_show_ids: - Items are shown using their item ids instead of their names
itemblocker.text.item_show_names: - Items are shown using their item names instead of their ids
itemblocker.text.looks_like_name: - Will look like this: Grass Block
